_comment: What this simulator is deliberately built against. patch_check.py reads
it; nothing writes it. Editing it is how you say 'yes, follow PBE' -- and
leaving it alone is how you say 'not yet', which is the point of it
existing. Bump `patch` and `accepted` only once you have actually looked.
acknowledged: a value that disagrees with the reference on purpose. Both
numbers are recorded, so the exemption expires the moment either side
moves and the disagreement becomes a new one nobody has looked at.
card_values: numbers CommunityDragon does not carry -- ability damage and
cast times -- read off the champion card by a person on the patch named.
The checker confirms the code still says this; only you can confirm the
spell_data_published: champions whose bin now carries real spell
DataValues instead of the template's placeholders, and whose numbers have
since been read against them. The checker names any that are published but
not listed here -- that is the prompt to go and look, not a failure.
patch: 18.2b (official mid-patch notes 2026-09-14 + lolchess live card; cdragon pbe)

Caitlyn.maxMana.why: -1 disables casting entirely (canCast needs fullMana > -1). Headshot is an attack replacement, not a cast, so she must never spend mana.

Kayle.maxMana.why: Her card reads 0/0 mana -- she has no ability resource at all. 0 would make canCast() true on every frame (curMana >= fullMana, and fullMana > -1), so -1 is the only value that means what the card does. Solar Judgement is a passive, handled by KayleAscensions.

MasterYi.maxMana.why: Same as Caitlyn: Double Strike is a passive third attack, handled by MasterYiUlt, not a real cast.

Rapidfire.per_attack_scaling[4].why: Official 18.2 notes: AS per attack 3/5/9/15% -> 3/5/8/12%. Not on PBE; cdragon's pbe dump lags the live build and still reads 9.

Rapidfire.per_attack_scaling[5].why: Official 18.2 notes: AS per attack 3/5/9/15% -> 3/5/8/12%. Not on PBE; cdragon's pbe dump lags the live build and still reads 15.

Solar.threshold1_resists.why: Official 18.2 notes: three-3-star Armor/MR 15 -> 12. Not on PBE; cdragon's pbe dump lags the live build and still reads 15.

MasterYi.ad.why: Official 18.2 notes and the live lolchess card say 60 (was 65); cdragon's pbe dump lags the live build and reads 62.

Alune.note: Authored, and wrong. The bin says PrimaryMagicDamage 160/240/380 and MagicDamage 380/570/900; the card says 55/83/500 per moonshard and 2350/3600/7500 for the full moon, and the card is what the game shows. Authored is not the same as correct.

Akali.apAbilityScaling.read_on: unverified. Riot publishes only one entry per Adaptor champion and Akali's is the AD form (DA_18_Akali_AD), so neither cdragon nor any card site carries this row -- it has to come off the client with AP items on her. This is also what blocks canFourStar on Akali: the AD rows have their 4-star column (645 AD + 40 AP, 135 AD Burning) but this one does not.
